notes: credential_scout (crates/susi-gemi/src/credential_scout.rs) enumerates every configured remote-cloud credential via effective_inference_endpoints + resolve_api_key, probes each with the cheapest authenticated call (zero-token GET {api_base}/models with the vendor's auth scheme — Bearer, x-api-key, x-goog-api-key), classifies live/expired/unauthorized/rate-limited/unknown through the shared classify_failure taxonomy, and records fingerprinted evidence: failure verdicts feed cloud_eligibility::record_probe so failover steers around dead keys, and ScoutReport::format renders the single report with per-credential status, detail and truncated sha-256 fingerprint — never the secret, even when a provider echoes it back. scout_configured_once is wired into register_configured_cloud_endpoints (reached from daemon composition and the discovery pipeline), interval-gated at 300s so repeat registrations stay free. Keys are marked, never deleted.
